## Thanks for visiting our Career Page. Please review our open positions and apply to the positions that match your qualifications.

## Growth Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS)

Remote

Full Time

Mid Level

[Share](https://veem.applytojob.com/app/share/lrgCsBDuFF)

**Growth Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS)**

**Remote, Canada - Full-Time**

**Role: Growth Marketing / Demand Generation**

**Location: Remote within Canada**

**Compensation: Salary + Bonus + Stock Options + Health Benefits + 3 Weeks Vacation**

**Team: Marketing**

**Reports to: Growth Manager, with direct exposure to the Senior Marketing Manager**

**Role Type: Individual Contributor**

**About Veem**

Veem is a global payments fintech serving more than 1.5 million businesses across 100+ countries. We help businesses move money globally through a platform that includes global payments, virtual accounts, global cards, and stablecoin settlement capabilities.

Through partners including Visa and Bridge, a Stripe company, Veem combines modern financial infrastructure with practical tools that make business payments faster, simpler, and more accessible.

We are building the next generation of global business payments for companies navigating increasingly complex financial operations.

**Why Join Veem**

**Impact:** Own growth initiatives that directly influence pipeline, revenue, retention, and customer lifetime value.

**Growth:** Help scale a global fintech platform serving more than 1.5 million businesses.

**Ownership:** Build and operate measurable programs across the entire customer journey.

**Collaboration:** Work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Product to solve meaningful growth challenges.

**Innovation:** Apply experimentation, automation, intent data, and AI-enabled workflows to modernize how Veem grows.

Job Description — Growth Marketing Manager

**About the Role**

Veem is hiring a hands-on, strategic Growth Marketing Manager to drive scalable, data-led growth across our B2B funnel. You will own initiatives spanning acquisition, activation, pipeline creation, revenue, retention, and expansion.

This role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Product. You will develop demand-generation programs, improve funnel conversion, strengthen product-led and sales-assisted motions, and create a disciplined experimentation engine focused on measurable business outcomes.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on:

Full-funnel growth strategy and execution

Demand generation, ABM, and paid acquisition

Lifecycle marketing and customer expansion

Conversion-rate optimization and experimentation

Marketing automation and AI-enabled workflows

Analytics, attribution, and revenue performance

This is not a role focused solely on brand awareness or top-of-funnel lead volume. Success requires direct ownership of pipeline quality, conversion, revenue impact, and growth efficiency.

**The ideal candidate can:**

Translate business goals into measurable growth programs

Balance strategic planning with hands-on campaign execution

Identify and resolve friction across complex B2B buying journeys

Build strong operating relationships with Sales and Product

Use data to prioritize opportunities and improve performance

Lead projects and develop team members without relying on formal authority

You will work with stakeholders across the business to establish growth priorities, execute programs quickly, and build repeatable systems that support Veem’s continued expansion.

**What You’ll Do**

Full-Funnel Growth

Own the growth strategy across acquisition, activation, pipeline, revenue, retention, and expansion.

Drive pipeline through inbound, outbound, product-led, paid, partnership, and account-based channels.

Balance product-led growth with sales-assisted motions across different customer segments.

Identify funnel constraints and prioritize the opportunities with the greatest revenue impact.

Demand Generation and Paid Acquisition

Build and optimize demand-generation, ABM, paid search, paid social, and performance marketing programs.

Manage campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads.

Use ICP-based targeting and intent data to reach high-value accounts and buying groups.

Develop programs for audiences across North America, Europe, and other priority international markets.

Experimentation and Conversion

Design and execute rapid experiments across the website, onboarding, lifecycle, and acquisition channels.

Improve conversion across demos, trials, self-serve signups, and other key customer journeys.

Develop clear hypotheses, testing plans, measurement frameworks, and actionable recommendations.

Turn successful experiments into repeatable, scalable growth programs.

Lifecycle and Expansion

Build email, nurture, onboarding, reactivation, retention, and expansion programs.

Partner with Product to improve activation, onboarding, and product-led growth motions.

Use behavioral and customer data to create relevant lifecycle experiences.

Increase engagement, product adoption, retention, and customer lifetime value.

Sales and Product Partnership

Partner with Sales on ICP definition, account targeting, messaging, lead quality, pipeline creation, and sales velocity.

Improve MQL-to-SQL conversion and alignment across funnel stages.

Collaborate with Product on activation, onboarding, product positioning, and growth priorities.

Create clear feedback loops among Marketing, Sales, Product, and customer-facing teams.

Analytics and Marketing Operations

Own growth reporting, attribution, forecasting, and performance optimization.

Build dashboards tracking CAC, LTV, ROAS, conversion rates, pipeline contribution, revenue, and retention.

Maintain reliable measurement across marketing automation, CRM, analytics, and advertising systems.

Use data to communicate results, guide investment decisions, and prioritize future experiments.

Automation and Team Enablement

Manage marketing automation and AI-enabled workflows or agents.

Identify opportunities to use AI to improve research, campaign execution, personalization, analysis, and operational efficiency.

Support and develop marketing team members through clear priorities, feedback, and shared operating practices.

Evaluate new channels, technologies, and growth strategies that could create scalable opportunities.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

4–8+ years of experience in B2B growth, demand generation, performance marketing, revenue marketing, product growth, or lifecycle marketing.

Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or cross-border payments.

Experience operating in a growth-stage company, ideally with approximately 100–500 employees or a comparable environment.

A proven record of generating qualified pipeline and revenue, beyond top-of-funnel activity metrics.

Strong understanding of B2B funnels, including lead, MQL, SQL, opportunity, and closed-won stages.

Hands-on paid acquisition experience across Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, paid search, or paid social.

Experience with funnel optimization, conversion-rate optimization, and structured experimentation.

Experience building lifecycle, nurture, reactivation, retention, or expansion programs.

Strong working knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, attribution, conversion, and pipeline reporting.

Hands-on experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, or comparable CRM and marketing automation platforms.

Experience working with analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, SQL, or similar platforms.

Experience using or managing AI-enabled tools, agents, or automated workflows.

Strong cross-functional partnership skills, particularly with Sales and Product teams.

A strategic but hands-on working style, with the ability to prioritize and execute in an ambiguous environment.

Experience leading projects, mentoring colleagues, or managing and developing team members.

**Bonus Qualifications**

Strong bonus points for candidates with:

Product-led growth or hybrid product-led and sales-assisted experience

Account-based marketing and ICP-based targeting expertise

6sense or other intent-data platform experience

Experience optimizing demo, trial, or self-serve signup journeys

Campaign experience across Canada, the United States, Europe, or other international markets

Technical fluency with tracking, integrations, APIs, and growth tooling

Experience marketing global payments, virtual accounts, card products, or stablecoin-enabled financial services

**What Success Looks Like**

Pipeline generation increases across priority segments and markets.

Lead quality and conversion improve from MQL through SQL and closed-won revenue.

Customer acquisition becomes more efficient, with measurable improvements in CAC and ROAS.

Website, onboarding, lifecycle, and product journeys convert more effectively.

Marketing, Sales, and Product operate from shared growth priorities and reliable funnel data.

A consistent experimentation program produces clear learnings and scalable growth opportunities.

Lifecycle programs contribute meaningfully to activation, retention, expansion, and customer lifetime value.

Marketing automation and AI-enabled workflows improve execution speed, personalization, and team efficiency.
